property_summary: For any caller equal to the contract owner and any strictly positive amount, calling sendTo with a NON-ZERO receiver always succeeds (does not revert) on the reference C, while the mutant that requires receiver==address(0) will revert for some non-zero receivers, so the universal rule is: owner calls to sendTo(nonzero_receiver, amount>0) must not revert on the reference.
change_summary: Invert the zero-address check to forbid non-zero addresses (require receiver == address(0)), causing different observable failures/successes.
